title: kangarooking/cangjie-skill: Turn long-form knowledge into reusable agent skills
friendlyTitle: Cangjie-skill turns books and videos into instructions an agent can reuse
summary: Cangjie-skill is a bilingual workflow for distilling books, long videos, podcasts and courses into executable agent skills. The repository includes staged extraction, verification, testing and delivery templates, and had about 5,800 GitHub stars when reviewed.
friendlySummary: This project provides a step-by-step method for changing long books, videos, podcasts and courses into reusable AI skills. It had about 5,800 GitHub stars.
whyItMatters: Use it as a structured starting point for turning reference material into repeatable agent procedures rather than one-off summaries. The workflow’s verification and pressure-testing stages are especially useful when accuracy matters, though non-Chinese readers may rely on the English documentation or translation.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it when you want an AI agent to apply lessons later, not only write a summary once. Its checks and tests can help make the result more trustworthy.
